create_jotaibench_dataset: create a JotaiBenchDataset instance to access compile-only C benchmarks from GitHub
create_jotaibench_runnable_dataset: create a JotaiBenchRunnableDataset instance to access runnable C benchmarks from GitHub
compile_all_jotaibench: compile all C benchmarks in the JotaiBenchDataset to LLVM bitcode in parallel
benchmark_from_parsed_uri: resolve a BenchmarkUri to a BenchmarkWithSource by compiling C to bitcode on demand
configure_runnable_benchmark: configure a benchmark with build and run commands using BenchmarkDynamicConfig
